product_overview: Magic Car Repair Mobile is an AI-assisted, multi-tenant automotive service platform for both shop operators and vehicle owners. It combines customer self-service, shop operations management, real-time communication, and analytics in one mobile application with Turkish and English support.
core_goals: Provide secure role-based access for system admins, shop staff, and customers
Enable end-to-end shop operations including customers, vehicles, work orders, parts, invoices, appointments, and employees
Support customer self-service for diagnosis, quote requests, portal access, work order tracking, and profile management
Deliver AI-assisted vehicle diagnosis and shop-side support for repair recommendations and stock-aware workflows
Expose operational analytics for dashboard, revenue, and fleet efficiency reporting
Send and manage notifications, messages, and real-time updates through authenticated backend APIs
Maintain tenant isolation through client-scoped data access and server-side authorization

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Provides a liveness endpoint for monitoring and load balancer verification.
user_flows: GET /health without authentication -> Receive 200 with Healthy status -> Monitoring system marks service as available
GET /health when API is down -> Receive network error or non-200 response -> Monitoring system flags service as unavailable

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Handles login, registration, password reset initiation, refresh token issuance, and secure session bootstrap.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with JWT access token and user payload -> Use token for subsequent authenticated API calls
POST /api/Auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 400 validation or authentication error -> Remain on login screen and show error message
POST /api/Auth/register with valid registration data -> Receive 200 with registration response -> Proceed to next onboarding or login step
POST /api/Auth/register with missing or invalid required fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> Prompt user to correct the form
POST /api/Auth/refresh-token with valid refresh token -> Receive 200 with new token response -> Continue authenticated session
POST /api/Auth/refresh-token with expired or invalid refresh token -> Receive authorization or token error -> Force user to login again
POST /api/Auth/forgot-password with registered phone or account details -> Receive 200 success response -> Continue password reset flow

POST /api/Auth/forgot-password with invalid or unregistered input -> Receive 200 or controlled error response depending on security policy -> Show generic reset guidance without exposing account existence

features.name: Customers Management
features.description: Supports shop-side customer CRUD and listing operations with tenant isolation.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Customers with token -> Receive 200 customer list for the current client
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Customers with token -> Receive 403 forbidden for wrong role
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Customers with valid customer data -> Receive 200 customer record -> Use created customer in shop workflows
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Customers/{id} for an existing customer -> Receive 200 customer detail -> Open detail screen
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Customers/{id} for a missing customer -> Receive 404 not found -> Show empty/error state
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> PUT /api/Customers/{id} with updated fields -> Receive 200 updated customer -> Refresh customer detail
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> DELETE /api/Customers/{id} -> Receive 200 success -> Remove customer from listing

features.name: Parts Inventory
features.description: Manages parts catalog browsing, low-stock visibility, creation, and bulk deletion for shop inventory.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Parts with token -> Receive 200 part list with search and pagination
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Parts/low-stock -> Receive 200 low-stock part list -> Highlight parts that need restocking
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Parts with valid part data -> Receive 200 created part -> Add item to inventory
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Parts/{id} for an existing part -> Receive 200 part detail -> Open part detail screen
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Parts/bulk-delete with valid ids -> Receive 200 bulk delete result -> Remove selected parts
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Parts/{id} for a missing part -> Receive 404 or not found style error -> Show error state
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Parts/bulk-delete with invalid ids -> Receive error or partial success result -> Show which ids failed

features.name: Work Orders
features.description: Manages the work order lifecycle, list, detail, status updates, approval queue, and related shop operations.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/WorkOrders -> Receive 200 work order list -> Open a specific work order detail with GET /api/WorkOrders/{id}

POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/WorkOrders/{id} for an existing work order -> Receive 200 work order detail -> Show customer, vehicle, parts, labor, and timeline
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/WorkOrders with valid work order data -> Receive 200 created work order -> Use returned order in shop queue
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/WorkOrders/{id}/status with a valid transition -> Receive 200 updated work order -> Refresh status timeline
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/WorkOrders/pending-approvals -> Receive 200 pending approvals list -> Show orders awaiting customer approval
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/WorkOrders -> Receive 403 forbidden for wrong role -> Prevent access to shop-only work order list

POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/WorkOrders/{id}/status with an invalid transition or missing status -> Receive 400 error -> Keep current work order state unchanged
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/WorkOrders/{id} for a missing record -> Receive 404 not found -> Show work order not found message

features.name: Vehicles
features.description: Provides customer vehicle listing and creation endpoints used by shop workflows and customer ownership views.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Vehicles -> Receive 200 vehicle list -> Browse all vehicles in the tenant
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Vehicles with valid vehicle data -> Receive 200 created vehicle -> Link vehicle to a customer
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Vehicles/customer/{customerId} for an existing customer -> Receive 200 vehicle list -> Show customer-owned vehicles
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Vehicles/customer/{customerId} for a customer with no vehicles -> Receive 200 empty list -> Show empty state
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Vehicles/customer/{customerId} for another customer -> Receive 403 or tenant/role error -> Prevent unauthorized access

features.name: Employees
features.description: Supports staff listing and creation for shop administration.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop admin credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Employees -> Receive 200 employee list -> Display shop staff directory
POST /api/Auth/login with shop admin credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Employees with valid staff data -> Receive 200 employee record -> Add employee to roster
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Employees -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Block customer access to staff management
POST /api/Auth/login with shop admin credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Employees with invalid or incomplete data -> Receive validation error -> Prompt user to correct input

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Displays high-level shop metrics and operational summaries for authenticated staff and administrators.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Dashboard -> Receive 200 dashboard summary -> Show charts and KPI cards
POST /api/Auth/login with employee credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Dashboard -> Receive 200 dashboard summary -> Show tenant-scoped operational metrics
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Dashboard -> Receive 403 forbidden or role error -> Prevent customer access to shop dashboard
POST /api/Auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Dashboard when tenant has no data -> Receive 200 with empty or zeroed metrics -> Show empty-state dashboard

features.name: Invoices
features.description: Allows shop users to create and view invoices associated with work orders.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Invoices with valid invoice data -> Receive 200 created invoice -> Link invoice to a work order
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Invoices/{id} for an existing invoice -> Receive 200 invoice detail -> Display invoice data
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Invoices/{id} for a missing invoice -> Receive 404 not found -> Show invoice not found state
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Invoices with invalid data -> Receive validation error -> Prevent invoice creation

features.name: Accounting
features.description: Surfaces income, expense, and cash flow reporting for financial tracking.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Incomes -> Receive 200 income list -> Review revenue records
POST /api/Auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Expenses -> Receive 200 expense list -> Review expense records
POST /api/Auth/login with manager credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/AccountingReports/cash-flow -> Receive 200 cash flow report -> Display financial summary
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/AccountingReports/cash-flow -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Block non-shop access to accounting data

features.name: Quote Requests
features.description: Allows customers and shop staff to manage quote request workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/quote-requests/open -> Receive 200 open quote requests -> Show incoming quote queue
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/quote-requests with valid request data -> Receive 200 created quote request -> Add request to workflow
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/quote-requests/open -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Prevent customer from viewing shop inbox
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/quote-requests/open when no requests exist -> Receive 200 empty list -> Show no open quote requests

features.name: Customer Portal
features.description: Provides customer self-service access to work orders and profile data.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/customer-portal/profile -> Receive 200 customer profile -> Display account details
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/customer-portal/work-orders -> Receive 200 work order list -> Show customer-owned service orders
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/customer-portal/profile -> Receive 403 forbidden -> Block shop users from customer portal
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/customer-portal/work-orders when customer has no records -> Receive 200 empty list -> Show empty portal state

features.name: AI Assistant
features.description: Offers AI chat and diagnosis capabilities for authenticated users, with support for mock provider behavior in development.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/AI/chat with a message -> Receive 200 chat response -> Render assistant reply
POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/AI/diagnose with symptoms or vehicle context -> Receive 200 diagnosis response -> Show estimated issues and next steps
POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/AI/chat with invalid or empty payload -> Receive validation error -> Prompt user to enter a message
POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/AI/diagnose with unsupported or insufficient input -> Receive error or low-confidence response -> Show fallback guidance

features.name: Appointments
features.description: Supports service appointment scheduling and appointment listing.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Appointments -> Receive 200 appointment list -> Display calendar entries
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Appointments with valid appointment data -> Receive 200 created appointment -> Add booking to schedule
POST /api/Auth/login with shop credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Appointments with invalid date or missing fields -> Receive validation error -> Prompt correction
POST /api/Auth/login with customer credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Appointments -> Receive 403 forbidden if endpoint is shop-only -> Prevent unauthorized scheduling access

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Lists user notifications and allows authenticated users to mark them as read.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Notifications/my-notifications -> Receive 200 notification list -> Display unread and read items
POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Notifications/{id}/read for a valid notification -> Receive 200 success -> Mark notification as read

POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> POST /api/Notifications/{id}/read for a missing notification -> Receive error or not found response -> Keep notification unread state unchanged
POST /api/Auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive JWT token -> GET /api/Notifications/my-notifications when none exist -> Receive 200 empty list -> Show empty notifications state

known_limitations.issue: Most endpoints require JWT and role-based permissions; customer role gets 403 on shop endpoints
known_limitations.impact: Tests must login as admin@magiccar.com (SystemAdmin) for broad API coverage

known_limitations.issue: Multi-tenant data isolation via ClientId; empty shop may return empty lists
known_limitations.impact: Some list endpoints return 200 with empty arrays without seed data beyond bootstrap admin

known_limitations.issue: External payment and SMS providers may be disabled in development
known_limitations.impact: Payment and messaging endpoints may return errors or no-ops when not configured
